subject: Vendor cascade flowdown – approval required for new subprocessor
messages:
From: Betsy Sims <betsy.sims@vendorco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed subprocessor (EdgeCache Labs) + requested flow-down

Hi Monica / Aditya —

Following our onboarding call, VendorCo intends to engage a caching/CDN subprocessor, EdgeCache Labs (edgecache@example.com), to improve global delivery latency for Acme usage. We expect EdgeCache to handle only encrypted tokenized payloads (no PII) and to host ingress/egress logs for 30 days.

Attached is a proposed subprocessor matrix and our suggested redline to the DPA and Order Form to include flow-down language and audit rights. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires additional evidence or specific contract language before we proceed?

Quick summary: 
- Subprocessor: EdgeCache Labs (US)
- Purpose: edge caching / delivery optimization
- Data: encrypted request/response payloads, KV caching only (no long-term storage)
- Retention: transient; logs kept 30 days

Attachments: [subproc_matrix.csv] [redline_subproc_20270523.docx]

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Betsy Sims

VendorCo

Team — forwarding VendorCo's notice. They want to add EdgeCache Labs to accelerate delivery for Acme. Key asks from VendorCo: DPA redline + Order Form amendment.

Please review and advise:
- Legal: what specific flowdown language do we need in the DPA/Order Form to preserve Redwood's obligations to Acme (audit rights, breach notification, permitted purpose limits)?
- Security: what evidence do we require from EdgeCache (SOC2, pentest, CVE policy) before we approve?
- Commercial/Procurement (Aditya): will we need an orderform amendment for any change in fees or SLA that affects Acme?

I've attached their matrix and redline. If we can get a short checklist/legal redline today I will respond to Betsy with timeline constraints.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Proposed subprocessor (EdgeCache Labs) + requested flow-down

Monica — quick legal read below. I annotated VendorCo's redline and added a parallel DPA addendum suggestion. High level: we can approve conditional on the following minimums.

Required items (legal):
1) DPA addendum with explicit flow-down: subprocessor must accept the same data protection obligations as in our DPA with Acme (copy clauses for processing, security, purpose limitation).
2) Audit and audit-assist clause: right to request evidence and, if needed, an independent audit within reasonable notice; VendorCo must coordinate.
3) Breach notification: subprocessor must notify VendorCo within 48 hours of discovery; VendorCo must then notify Redwood within 24 hours of VendorCo's awareness.
4) Limitations on onward transfers: prohibit further subcontracting without prior written consent.
5) Security baselines: require either SOC 2 Type II report within last 12 months or a completed security questionnaire plus evidence of regular pentests and CVE response policy.
6) Data minimization & retention: confirm that EdgeCache will not persist payloads beyond transient caching (explicit max retention 72 hours for cache, 30 days for logs only if legally required).
7) Encryption controls: TLS in transit and encryption-at-rest for any persisted logs; key management responsibilities clarified.

I've attached Legal_redlines_20270523.docx with inline edits. From a contract standpoint, we should ask Procurement to budget the DocuSign and orderform amendment (Aditya).

If Security can confirm what evidence (SOC2 vs questionnaire) will suffice, we can push back a formal response to VendorCo with the path and a 2-week horizon for final sign-off.

[Attachment: legal_redlines_20270523.docx]

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Betsy Sims <betsy.sims@vendorco.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procure@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed subprocessor (EdgeCache Labs) + requested flow-down — next steps

Betsy — thanks for the heads up and the materials. Good news: we can proceed but require a short set of conditions before we sign off. Summary of next steps and required deliverables:

Action items for VendorCo / EdgeCache (requested by Redwood):
1) DPA addendum: provide a signed addendum that flows down Redwood's DPA obligations to EdgeCache (we will share a template).
2) Evidence: provide either a SOC 2 Type II report dated within last 12 months OR complete the attached security questionnaire and provide recent pentest evidence.
3) Retention & scope confirmations: written confirmation that EdgeCache will not persist request/response payloads beyond a 72-hour cache window; logs retention limited to 30 days and scoped to connection-level metadata only.
4) No further delegation: EdgeCache must not subcontract additional processors without prior written consent from Redwood/Acme.
5) Audit coordination: VendorCo to coordinate any audit requests; Redwood reserves audit-rights limited to impact on Acme workloads.
6) Order Form amendment: Aditya will prepare an Order Form amendment to reflect the addition of EdgeCache and any fee/SLA changes (if applicable). Please confirm acceptance or provide redlines by close of business 2027-06-07.

Please attach the SOC2 report or completed questionnaire to your reply. If you anticipate any issues with the timeline, let us know and we'll schedule a short call to resolve.

I will loop in Aditya for the Order Form and Karthik for final DPA language; Rishi will confirm security acceptance criteria.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Lead, Acme Corp
Redwood Inference
